games.name: [HALLOWEEN] TECHY
games.desc:
Techy is a fast-paced FPS (first-person shooter), based on complex movement mechanics and adapted for the duels gameplay format

⚠️ This game is difficult; it includes MOVEMENT INACCURACY (you cannot move and be accurate with your gun)

- Hop on the duels pads in the lobby to get started
- Press the practice button or enter the practice portal and refine your skills
- Press PLAY to access a wide variety of game modes such as FFA and SURF
- Complete daily and seasonal quests to earn rewards
- Use coins and premium currency to buy cases and unlock rare gun skins and cosmetics

Experienced players, please help teach newer players how to also enjoy this type of gameplay. Join our socials to learn more about mechanics and get involved with the community 👍

⚠️ This game is in an Alpha-Testing stage; please expect bugs and unfinished content
⚠️Cheaters/exploiters/Farmers will be permanently banned.

🔊 If you have access to Voice Chat, you can now use Voice Chat in servers. Additionally, if you want to play with only players who have Voice, then press the microphone icon on the top left to get sent to a VC only server!

games.name: [G0Z] Delta Worlds RPG
games.desc:
Public-Alpha V PA 4.9.7 Chaser Route

One day you wake up and your friend Shopkeeper calls you to help him with one little thing: Saving the world... the Earth...
The game has the same world logic as DELTARUNE - there are LIGHT and DARK worlds, which had their balance shift, but three Delta Warriors managed to set up the balance, containing 3 types of worlds: LIGHT, DARK and SHADOWED. But today, SHADOWED worlds have begun to shift the balance... in which the Earth might be at its edge.

This game has Undertale/Deltarune inspired turn-based RPG battle system, with its own story, music, sprites and 3D overworld!
The game was inspired by Undertale/Deltarune by Toby Fox, so go support him!

We highly recommend playing UNDERTALE or DELTARUNE before playing this game to better understand the battle mechanics.

Credits are located in the game's settings.
